_verification_registry_redeploy.status: EXECUTED - the live VerificationRegistry was redeployed to carry the v2 six-arg recordVerificationZK(a,b,c,pub,recordType,deadline) (selector 0x423a45b6). The prior registry 0x8bA836 (now VerificationRegistry_4arg_legacy) was deployed at 21c9b15, BEFORE PR #7 (64ea1f8) added recordType/deadline, so its bytecode only dispatches the OLD 4-arg selector 0xdd080593; the v2 server/phone send 0x423a45b6, which the old bytecode had no case for -> bare revert -> `execution reverted, data: 0x` on the groomer ZK export.
